artworks.title: Philibert-Emmanuel de Beaumanoir Lavardin
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a bust-length portrait of a man. The man is facing slightly to the left, with his body turned towards the viewer and his gaze directed at them. He has long, slightly wavy hair and wears a skullcap. His facial features include a prominent nose and a slightly serious expression. He wears a robe with a large collar and a chain with a large cross pendant around his neck. The portrait is framed with an intricate border featuring oak leaves and acorns, and a coat of arms with ornate design elements is in the lower part of the frame. The background of the portrait is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Philibert-Emmanuel de Beaumanoir Lavardin
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image displays a man in a portrait from the waist up, facing slightly left with a composed expression. He has a mustache, goatee, shoulder-length wavy hair, wearing a clerical robe with a visible large collar and a cape. He wears a chain with a cross pendant around his neck. The background has a textured pattern within an oval frame formed by dual lines. Below the oval, an ornate emblem features a shield with a building, with inscriptions "Thé: Chauenpin Pinx" on the left and "Rob: Nanteuil Sculpebat 1658" on the right.

artworks.title: Michel Larcher
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a formal portrait style. The man has a serious expression, long, narrow nose, defined lips, and shoulder-length wavy hair. He wears a robe with broad sleeves, intricate patterns, and a wide, white collar with pointed corners. A detailed emblem is below the oval frame surrounding the portrait. The background has finely engraved horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Lamoignon
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait from the waist up, with long curly hair and a trimmed mustache and goatee. He is wearing a garment with a fur collar, set against a plain background in a rich, dark oval frame with an inscription. Below the portrait is lettering that may identify the individual or provide context.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Lamoignon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body in a three-quarter position facing slightly to his left. The man has a long face with a pointed chin and a prominent nose, long dark wavy hair falling just past his shoulders, a mustache, and a small beard. He is dressed in a fur garment with visible fur lining. The image is framed by an oval border with inscriptions, and a coat of arms with intricate detailing is below the frame. The background has ornamental elements and text, with the focus remaining on the central figure.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Lamoignon
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrait from the chest up, looking towards the right. He has medium-length wavy hair, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a mustache with a small goatee. He wears a detailed garment with a fur-lined cloak or shawl over his shoulders and visible buttons on the inner shirt. The man appears well-dressed, and the portrait is framed in an oval with a coat of arms at the bottom. The background consists of parallel lines and an ornate border.

artworks.title: Marechal de La Meilleraye
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing an upper body view of a man turned slightly to the left. The man's hair is long, wavy, and falls past his shoulders. He has a serious expression, pronounced cheekbones, a neatly trimmed mustache, and a pointed goatee. He is wearing formal armor with intricate detailing, including visible rivets and decorative patterns, along with a large white lace collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame. At the bottom is an ornate shield with various heraldic symbols, including a crescent moon. The background of the image is a simple lined pattern.

artworks.title: Pierre Lallemant
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a portrait of a man. He is portrayed looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The man has a prominent forehead, short and combed-back thinning hair, and wears ecclesiastical attire, including a loose-fitting garment with pleated detailing and a distinctive collar. Fabric drapes over his shoulders, likely part of his robe. The portrait is enclosed in an ornate oval frame with an inscription along its border. The background features intricate line work that contrasts with the smooth rendering of the man's figure.

artworks.title: Denis de La Barde
artworks.description: This black and white engraving depicts a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left and looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinct features, a high forehead, and a composed expression. His hair is shoulder-length and wavy, and he wears a skullcap. He is dressed in clerical robes, notably a dark, high-collared garment with intricate detailing. Around his neck hangs a large cross on a chain. The portrait is framed by an ornate leaf-patterned border and is placed on a pedestal-like structure displaying a decorative shield with a design. The background is filled with stippled shading that accentuates the contrast and contours of the engraving.

artworks.title: Don Juan of Austria
artworks.description: The image depicts a person within an oval frame. The person has long, curly hair, a mustache, deep-set eyes, and is wearing an intricately designed high-collared garment with a cross-shaped medal around their neck. They are dressed in armor with visible parts of a breastplate and arm braces. Surrounding the frame are armor and weaponry elements, and the background shows decorative banners and laurel leaves. The name "Don Juan de Austria" is inscribed at the bottom of the frame.

artworks.title: Claude Joly
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a seated man. He has a round face, defined features, curly medium length hair, a receding hairline, and wears a skullcap. He is dressed in clerical clothing with a buttoned cassock and wears a chain with a cross pendant around his neck. The background includes an oval frame with inscriptions, decorative lines, and a coat of arms with various symbols.

artworks.title: Pierre Jeannin
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of an elderly man displayed in a half-body portrait. The man is positioned slightly turned to his right but faces forward, allowing the viewer to see his upper body. He has a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, and a long, full beard with short mustaches. His hair appears to be receding and is light in color. The man is wearing a dark coat with a high collar, over a shirt that has ornate buttons running down the center. The background is minimal but framed with an oval border. Below the portrait is a detailed platform with engraved text identifying the subject as Messire Pierre Jeannin.

artworks.title: Louis Hesselin
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side, with their head facing forward towards the viewer. They have distinctive facial features including a prominent nose, mustache, and deep-set eyes. Their hair is long, wavy, and appears voluminous, cascading around their shoulders. They are wearing a garment with a wide, ornate lace collar, and a dark cloak with buttons along the front. Surrounding the portrait is an elaborate oval frame etched into the image, adorned with detailed lines. Below the portrait, there is a decorative crest with intricate designs and symmetrical patterns, featuring a shield with various geometric shapes and an ornate topper resembling a helmet or face. The background within the frame is filled with finely drawn lines that add depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: Louis Hesselin
artworks.description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man. He is facing slightly to his left and looking towards the viewer. The man has detailed facial features, a moustache, and a composed expression. He has long, curly hair falling over his shoulders. He is dressed in formal attire with a large, lace-trimmed collar typical of the depicted period. The backdrop is an oval, textural pattern. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person, and no additional elements in the background beyond the textured oval design framing the subject.

artworks.title: Francois de Harlay
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man with wavy, shoulder-length hair, wearing a formal outfit with a large, white collar and an ornate necklace. He has a broad nose, pronounced cheeks, a full mouth, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. The background is a simple oval frame with an inscription.

artworks.title: Francois de Harlay
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing slightly to his right. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a calm expression, with features including a long nose and pursed lips. He wears a robe with a wide collar and a large insignia on his chest. The portrait is enclosed by an ornate oval border with wreath-like elements and intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Henri de Guenegaud
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is turned slightly to the side but faces towards the viewer in a three-quarter profile. His facial features are distinct, with a slim face, a slight mustache, and a pointed goatee. His curly hair reaches down around his collar, with a voluminous texture. He is dressed in a period garment with a high, ornate collar and a dark coat with intricate details. At the top of his collar is a decorative clamshell or lace. The portrait is within an oval frame with concentric lines around it. Below the portrait is a family crest with two lion figures on either side of a shield or emblem. The background consists of fine horizontal lines within the oval frame.

artworks.title: Francois Guenault
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up. He faces slightly to his left, with his facial features including a prominent nose, a slightly pursed mouth, and deep-set eyes. His hair is shoulder-length, curly, and voluminous, framing his face with cascading waves. The man wears a dark, elaborate robe and a large, white, square-collared fashion typical of the time period represented in the image. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with inscriptions. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, resembling a textured wall or patterned backdrop. A decorative element at the bottom of the frame adds to the historical aesthetic of the portrait.

artworks.title: Marechal de Guebriant
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man positioned facing slightly to the right. He has a long face with medium-length, curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. The man has a facial mole on his cheek. He is dressed in ornate armor with a draped fabric across his shoulder. Surrounding him is an oval frame with decorative elements, and below is a cartouche with family crests and embellishments. The background features intricate engravings.

artworks.title: Madame de Gillier
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a woman's portrait from the torso upwards, enclosed in an oval frame. She is facing the viewer with her gaze slightly to the left. She has a composed expression, arched eyebrows, and full lips. Her hair is styled in loose curls falling over her shoulders, partly pulled back. She wears a low-cut garment with ruffled edges and delicate details, fastened with a floral brooch at the neckline. She has a pearl necklace and an earring on one ear. The background features cross-hatching patterns, highlighting the vintage style of the illustration and the ornate border surrounding the portrait.

artworks.title: Melchior de Gillier
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a prominent nose, closed lips, a mustache, and a goatee. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair. He wears a dark garment with embroidery, a white lace collar, and the portrait is in an oval frame with text around it. There is a crest at the bottom center with intricate designs, including lions. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Pierre Gassendi
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving of a man. He is depicted facing slightly to his left with his body turned towards the viewer. The man has a mature facial appearance with a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a slight smile. He has short, receding hair, a neatly trimmed mustache, and goatee. He is dressed in a dark, full-sleeved robe with a wide white collar and buttons down the front. The background displays intricate line work framing the image in an oval shape. Below the portrait is a decorative inscription on a plinth stating “PETRVS GASSENDVS DINIENSIS” in Latin. The engraving is signed and dated to the right of the oval frame as "D. Nanteuil Faciebat 1658".

artworks.title: Cardinal de Furstenberg
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of an individual's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is facing forward with a slight tilt, showing their facial features. They have prominent facial features with a gentle expression and deep-set eyes. Their hair is voluminous and curly, falling around their face. The individual is dressed in an intricately patterned garment with a white collar. The background consists of a circular frame with inscribed text around the inner border.

artworks.title: Jean Fronteau
artworks.description: This engraving shows a man from his mid-torso upwards. He is slightly turned to the left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a high forehead, thin eyebrows, a neatly trimmed mustache, clean-shaven face, and short, neatly cropped hair. He is wearing a clerical robe with vertical stripes, and there is an intricate pattern on the attire and collar. The background features a finely detailed oval frame with inscriptions.
